```{python}
with open("../../homework/hw5/hw5_raw.txt", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    fin_lines = f.readlines()
fin_text = "".join(fin_lines)
clean_text = re.sub(r'\[.*?\]', '', fin_text)
```
```{python}
songs = re.split(r"\*[^*]*\*", clean_text)
songs = songs[1:]
```
```{python}
rows = []
songs_num = 0
title_search = re.search(r"^\s*([^\n]+)", fin_text)

for song in songs:
    songs_num += 1
    lines = re.split(r"[\n]+", song.lower()) 
    lines = [l for l in lines if l != ""]
    for l in lines:
        rows.append({"Line": l, "Songs": songs_num})

if title_search:
    title = title_search.group(1).strip()
else:
    title = f"Song {songs_num}"
    for t in title_search:
        rows.append({"Line": l, "Songs": songs_num, "Title": title})


fin_df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
```
```{python}
fin_df['Length'] = fin_df['Line'].str.split().str.len()
```
